author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록 · 여름에도 드물게 기록
summary: 해마다 수십 마리가 지나가는 나그네새로, 관목이 우거진 곳이나 경작지에서 지낸다. 도마뱀, 설치류, 작은 새, 곤충 따위를 잡아 나뭇가지나 철사에 꽂아 두는 습성이 있는데, 이렇게 둔 먹이를 잊어버리는 일이 잦다. 평소에는 물결치듯 오르내리며 날지만 먹이를 덮칠 때는 곧장 돌진한다. 국내에서는 전라남도 하태도·가거도와 제주도 등지에서 볼 수 있고, 국외에서는 인도에서 뉴기니까지 분포한다.

art.subject: Long-tailed Shrike (Lanius schach), adult of the grey-crowned Chinese form (sexes similar), as seen on Korean islands and coasts: crown, nape and upper mantle pale to mid grey; a broad black mask from the lores through the eye to the ear coverts, the forehead grey with at most a thin black line at the bill base; lower mantle, scapulars, back and rump rufous-buff; wings black with pale-edged tertials and a small white patch at the base of the primaries; throat and cheeks below the mask white; breast washed pale buff; flanks, lower belly and vent rufous-buff; tail long and graduated, blackish with narrow pale buff edges to the outer feathers. Bill blackish, stout and hooked; dark eye; legs blackish.
art.pose: perched on a shrub beside a small lizard spiked on a twig
art.scene: dense shrubs at the edge of cultivated fields on a southern Korean island such as Jeju; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched: pale grey crown and nape, black mask through the eye with a grey forehead, rufous-buff scapulars and rump, black wings with a small white patch, white throat, buff-washed breast, rufous-buff flanks, long graduated blackish tail, blackish hooked bill and legs
adult in flight, seen from above: grey crown and mantle, rufous rump, black wings with a small white primary patch, long dark tail with buff edges
art.build: Medium-large shrike, distinctly bigger and much longer-tailed than a Bull-headed Shrike, about the length of a Brown-eared Bulbul, with the tail making up nearly half the total length. Big head, stout black hooked bill. Legs short, blackish. Short rounded wings. Perches upright on bush tops, swinging its long tail; flight undulating, with a straight dash when attacking prey.
avoid: Do not paint the brown crown and back of Brown Shrike (Lanius cristatus) or the rufous crown of Bull-headed Shrike (Lanius bucephalus).
Do not paint a short tail; it is long and graduated.
Do not paint a large white wing panel and white tail sides; those belong to Chinese Grey Shrike (Lanius sphenocercus).
Do not paint the whole tail bright rufous; it is blackish with narrow buff edges.
Do not paint the whole face black or a broad black forehead band; the black is a mask through the eye and the throat is white.
